These are the final figures for the air pollution analysis

Setting up

Workspace:

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# Setting up the workspace 
if(Sys.getenv("RSTUDIO") == '1' & !knitr::is_html_output()) { # If using Rstudio and not rendering
  setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path))
} else if(Sys.getenv("RSTUDIO") != '1'){ # If using Rscript
  initial.options <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)
  file.arg.name <- "--file="
  script.name <- sub(file.arg.name, "", initial.options[grep(file.arg.name, initial.options)])
  script.basename <- dirname(script.name)
  setwd(file.path(getwd(), script.basename))
}
```

Building the cohort and cleaning the covariates

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# Decide cancer of interest:
# This analysis is focused on breast cancer 
select_cancer <- "breast_cancer"

# set if cancer is first ever any cancer (YES) - no previous cancers of any type (except NMSC)
# or first of its type (NO) -there may be previous diagnosis of other cancer (except NMSC)
first_ever <- "YES"

source("GS_analysis/Script/Cohort_Build.R")


# COHORT DEFINITION
# Menopausal Status
  # "post" - POSTMENOPAUSAL cohort
  # "pre" - PREMENOPAUSAL cohort
  # "all" - ENTIRE cohort
menopausal_status <- "all"

# EVENT DEFINITION
# ER status 
  # "positive" - positive er status BC coded as events only
  # "negative" - negative er status BC coded as events only
  # "all"- all BC coded as events
er_event <- "all"
# Menopausal Status
  # "post" - postmenopausal BC coded as events only
  # "pre" - premenopausal BC coded as events only
  # "all" - all BC coded as events
menopausal_event <- "all"

source("GS_analysis/Script/CleanCovariates_NAincluded.R")
source("GS_analysis/Script/CleanExposure.R")

complete_cohort <- complete_cohort %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(BMI)
  ) # Do not include those who have missing BMI
```

Analysis set up


```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# Time lag definitions

complete_cohort <- complete_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    meno_age_est = as.numeric(meno_age_est)
  )

complete_cohort_2lag <- complete_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    age_start365 = age_start365 + 730
  ) %>%
  filter(
    c_age365 > age_start365
  )

complete_cohort_5lag <- complete_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    age_start365 = age_start365 + 1825
  ) %>%
  filter(
    c_age365 > age_start365
  )

```

# Table 1: Data Description

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

nolag <- covariate(complete_cohort, bc_nolag) %>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Cohort: no time lag"
  )
twolag <- covariate(complete_cohort, bc_2lag)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Cohort: 2 year time lag"
  )
fivelag <- covariate(complete_cohort, bc_5lag)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Cohort: 5 year time lag"
  )

outcome <- bind_rows(nolag, twolag, fivelag) %>%
  mutate(
    Cases = case_when(
      Subcategories == 0 ~ 0, 
      TRUE ~ Cases
    ),
    `Rate per 1,000` = case_when(
      Subcategories == 0 ~ 0, 
      TRUE ~ `Rate per 1,000`
    ), 
    Subcategories = case_when(
      Subcategories == 1 ~ "Case", 
      Subcategories == 0 ~ "Not Case", 
      TRUE ~ "ERROR"
    )
  )

age <- covariate(complete_cohort, AgeEntry_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Age at study entry"
  )
yearofentry <- covariate(complete_cohort, matchyear_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Year of study entry"
  )

carstairs <- covariate(complete_cohort, Carstairs_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Carstairs index"
  )
bmi <- covariate(complete_cohort, BMI_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Body Mass Index (BMI)"
  )
smoking <- covariate(complete_cohort, Smoking_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Smoking"
  )
alcohol <- covariate(complete_cohort, Alcohol_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Alcohol"
  )
education <- covariate(complete_cohort, Educ_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Highest attained education"
  )

parity <- covariate(complete_cohort, Parity_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Parity"
  )
agefirstbirth <- covariate(complete_cohort, Birth1_age_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Age at first birth"
  )
HRT <- covariate(complete_cohort, HRT_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Hormone replacement therapy (HRT)"
  )
meno <- covariate(cohort_mensplit, Menopause_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Menopause", 
    Subcategories = case_when(
      is.na(Subcategories) ~ "Unknown", 
      TRUE ~ Subcategories
    )
  )
ER <- covariate(complete_cohort, ER_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Oestrogen Receptor (ER) status"
  )



table1 <- bind_rows(outcome,  meno, ER, age, yearofentry, carstairs, bmi, smoking, alcohol, education, parity, agefirstbirth, HRT) %>%
  mutate(
      Cases = paste0(format(Cases, big.mark = ",")),
      `Person Years` = paste0(format(`Person Years`, big.mark = ","))
  )

table1_tbl <- table1 %>%
    group_by(covariate) %>%
    gt(rowname_col = NULL) %>%
    # Center everything
    cols_align(
      align = "center",
      columns = everything()
    ) %>%
    # Bold the column headers
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) %>%
    # Style the group headers (time_lag)
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        cell_fill(color = "lightgray"),
        cell_borders(sides = "top"),
        cell_borders(sides = "bottom")
      ),
      locations = cells_row_groups(groups = everything())
    ) %>%
    # Add title
    tab_header(
      title = "Table 1: Generations Study Cohort Data Description")
    

table1_tbl

```

# Figure 2: Generations Study
## Panel A: Primary Outcome

```{r}
#| label: Figure 2 pan A
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

average_nolag_plot <- full_cohort_plot(all_results, lag_value = "nolag", exp_def = "average")

average_nolag_plot  + plot_annotation(
    title = "Particulate Matter Exposure and Breast Cancer Incidence",
     subtitle = "All hazard ratios calculated per 5 ug/m3 of exposure",
  caption = str_wrap(
    "Model A adjusted for year of entry into the study; Model B adjusted for A + individual (BMI, smoking, alcohol, education) and small level socioeconomic status (Carstairs Index); Model C adjusted for B + reproductive risk factors (parity, age at first birth, HRT, and menopausal status updated throughout follow up)",
    width = 100  # adjust this number to fit your plot
  ), 
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 22, hjust = 0.5), 
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0))
  )
```

## Proportional Hazards
```{r}
fullcohort <- proportionalhazards(complete_cohort, cohort_mensplit)
fullcohort %>%
separate(model, into = c("Pollutant", "Model"), sep = "_") %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Pollutant") %>%
  cols_label(Model = "Category")%>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Full Cohort Proportional Hazards"
  )

premen <- cohort_mensplit %>%
  filter(
    menobandf == "premenopausal"
  )
premen_ph <- proportionalhazards(premen, premen)
premen_ph %>%
separate(model, into = c("Pollutant", "Model"), sep = "_") %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Pollutant") %>%
  cols_label(Model = "Category")%>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Premenopausal Proportional Hazards"
  )

postmen <- cohort_mensplit %>%
  filter(
    menobandf == "postmenopausal"
  )
postmen_ph <- proportionalhazards(postmen, postmen)
postmen_ph %>%
separate(model, into = c("Pollutant", "Model"), sep = "_") %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Pollutant") %>%
  cols_label(Model = "Category")%>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Postmenopausal Proportional Hazards"
  )
```
